# erayy.com

> Eray Yapağcı: AI engineer and researcher (Bilkent CS '25). Author of balbal, open Turkish speech recognition (speech-to-text, STT, ASR) that runs offline on a CPU or a phone.

## balbal: open Turkish speech recognition

- [balbal-v2](https://erayy.com/balbal): two open Turkish speech-to-text models. balbal-v2 (45M parameters, Turkish) runs 236x faster than real time on 8 CPU threads and in real time on a 15-year-old Celeron with 1 thread. balbal-v2-manas (313M parameters, Turkish + English) makes the fewest meaning-changing errors of any open model on Mu-Bench (WER 8.20%, sigWER 14.89%; balbal-v2: 9.46% / 18.44%). Output is cased, punctuated text with word timestamps; numbers as digits.
- Install: `pip install balbal`, then `balbal run speech.wav` (Linux x86-64; the model downloads from Hugging Face on first run). Python: `balbal.transcribe("speech.wav")["text"]`.
- Weights: [huggingface.co/erayyapagci/balbal-v2](https://huggingface.co/erayyapagci/balbal-v2), [huggingface.co/erayyapagci/balbal-v2-manas](https://huggingface.co/erayyapagci/balbal-v2-manas) (ONNX, offline, CPU).
- Code (inference, streaming WebSocket server, training): [github.com/erayyap/balbal](https://github.com/erayyap/balbal), Apache 2.0.
- [Browser demo](https://erayy.com/stt-demo): try both models.
- [balbal-v1](https://erayy.com/balbal-v1) and [how balbal-v1 was built](https://erayy.com/balbal-blog).
